passages.text:
# Returns for LumaDock Home

LumaDock is a fictional desk hub used only for this demonstration.
Customers may return a LumaDock Home within 30 calendar days of delivery.
To start a return, open the Returns tab in the LumaDock desktop app and enter the order number.
The device, power adapter, and USB-C cable must be included in the return package.
Opened packaging is accepted if the device is undamaged.
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 7 business days after inspection.
Shipping charges are not refundable unless the delivered device was defective.
passages.title: LumaDock Return Policy

passages.text:
# Warranty bulletin

The limited warranty for LumaDock Home lasts 12 months from the delivery date.
The warranty covers manufacturing defects in the dock and supplied power adapter.
Accidental liquid damage is excluded from warranty coverage.
Keep the order receipt as proof of the delivery date.
passages.title: Retail Warranty Bulletin

passages.text:
# Delivery estimates

Standard shipping takes 4 to 6 business days after an order leaves the warehouse.
Express shipping takes 2 business days after dispatch.
Orders placed before 14:00 warehouse time on a business day are dispatched the same day.
A tracking number appears in the Orders tab after dispatch.
Address changes are available only before dispatch through the Orders tab.
LumaDock currently ships only within the fictional Northstar region.
passages.title: Shipping and Delivery

passages.title: Service Warranty Bulletin

passages.text:
# Idle behavior

LumaDock Home enters sleep mode after 15 minutes without a connected computer by default.
Change the sleep delay in Settings, Device, Sleep timer in LumaDesk.
Available sleep delays are 5, 15, and 30 minutes.
The status light slowly pulses white while the dock is asleep.
Reconnect the HOST cable to wake a sleeping dock.
passages.title: Sleep and Wake Settings

passages.text:
# Local use

LumaDesk can configure LumaDock Home without an internet connection after installation.
Display layouts and sleep preferences are stored locally on the device.
Diagnostic reports remain on the computer until the user exports them manually.
To export diagnostics, open Settings, choose Diagnostics, and select Save report.
The diagnostic report contains firmware version, port status, and recent error codes.
LumaDesk never sends diagnostic reports automatically.
passages.title: Offline Use and Diagnostics

# Connect LumaDock Home

Connect the supplied 65 W power adapter before attaching LumaDock Home to a computer.
Use the supplied USB-C cable to connect the port labeled HOST to the computer.
The status light turns solid white when setup is complete.
Install LumaDesk version 2.3 or later to configure display and sleep preferences.
LumaDock Home requires Windows 11 or macOS 14 or later.
Linux is not supported by LumaDesk.

passages.text:
# Caring for the dock

Unplug power and all cables before cleaning LumaDock Home.
Clean the aluminum enclosure with a dry, lint-free cloth.
Do not spray liquid into ports or immerse the device in water.
Store the device in a dry place between 5 and 35 degrees Celsius.
Leave at least 3 centimeters of clearance around the ventilation slots during use.

passages.text:
# External monitors

LumaDock Home supports one external display at up to 3840 by 2160 pixels at 60 Hz.
The computer USB-C port must support DisplayPort Alt Mode to use an external monitor.
Dual external displays are not supported by LumaDock Home.
Use an HDMI 2.0 cable shorter than 2 meters if the screen flickers.
If a monitor is blank, reconnect the HOST cable and select the HDMI input on the monitor.

passages.text:
# Returns for LumaDock Home

LumaDock is a fictional desk hub used only for this demonstration.
Customers may return a LumaDock Home within 30 calendar days of delivery.
To start a return, open the Returns tab in the LumaDock desktop app and enter the order number.
The device, power adapter, and USB-C cable must be included in the return package.
Opened packaging is accepted if the device is undamaged.
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 7 business days after inspection.
Shipping charges are not refundable unless the delivered device was defective.
passages.title: LumaDock Return Policy

passages.text:
# External monitors

LumaDock Home supports one external display at up to 3840 by 2160 pixels at 60 Hz.
The computer USB-C port must support DisplayPort Alt Mode to use an external monitor.
Dual external displays are not supported by LumaDock Home.
Use an HDMI 2.0 cable shorter than 2 meters if the screen flickers.
If a monitor is blank, reconnect the HOST cable and select the HDMI input on the monitor.
passages.title: Display Compatibility

passages.text:
# Local use

LumaDesk can configure LumaDock Home without an internet connection after installation.
Display layouts and sleep preferences are stored locally on the device.
Diagnostic reports remain on the computer until the user exports them manually.
To export diagnostics, open Settings, choose Diagnostics, and select Save report.
The diagnostic report contains firmware version, port status, and recent error codes.
LumaDesk never sends diagnostic reports automatically.
passages.title: Offline Use and Diagnostics

passages.text:
# Reset local settings

To factory reset LumaDock Home, hold the recessed reset button for 10 seconds while power is connected.
Release the reset button when the status light flashes amber three times.
A factory reset erases saved display layouts and sleep preferences from the device.
A factory reset does not delete files stored on the connected computer.
After a factory reset, reconnect the HOST cable and complete first-time setup.
passages.title: Factory Reset Procedure

passages.text:
# Caring for the dock

Unplug power and all cables before cleaning LumaDock Home.
Clean the aluminum enclosure with a dry, lint-free cloth.
Do not spray liquid into ports or immerse the device in water.
Store the device in a dry place between 5 and 35 degrees Celsius.
Leave at least 3 centimeters of clearance around the ventilation slots during use.
passages.title: Cleaning and Storage
